title: Switch to an electric car
tagline: The real cost compared, financing or a lease, insurance, charging cards and charging on your own sun.
trigger: You started paying at public chargers, or a car lease ends while you spend a lot on fuel.

steps.title: Petrol or electric: the real cost
steps.description: Your fuel, repairs and insurance from your own payments, next to an electric car over five years.
steps.why: KBC already sees your fuel, charging and garage payments. Nothing is shared.
steps.result: Your current car costs about €{car_monthly} a month. The electric comparison is ready (illustrative).

steps.title: Finance the electric car
steps.description: An electric car loan, approved in the app, usually at a lower rate than for a petrol car.
steps.why: Based on your own income and spending; no extra documents.

steps.title: Or lease it, all-in
steps.description: A private lease with insurance, maintenance and a home charger included.
steps.why: MoveSmart only receives your region, car, commute and budget range, never your income.
steps.result: MoveSmart sent two lease offers to compare with the loan.

steps.title: Insurance made for electric cars
steps.description: Electric car insurance that covers the battery and the charging cable.
steps.why: A standard policy often doesn't cover the battery.
steps.result: Electric car insurance ready to start on delivery day.

steps.title: Charge anywhere with one card
steps.description: A VAB charging card for public chargers, paid from your KBC account, plus roadside help for electric cars.
steps.why: VAB only receives your name, e-mail, region and car.

steps.title: Charge on your own sun
steps.description: Solar panels and a home battery so you charge at home for a fraction of the public price.
steps.why: Only shown if you own your home.
steps.result: Solar and battery estimate ready, sized for your car (illustrative).
